verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own first-party AI agent, Rudder AI, which lets users manage and interact with their workspace. However, it runs in Slack rather than inside the RudderStack app, and the evidence gives only a one-line description of what tasks it can carry out. The MCP server only serves external AI clients such as Claude or Cursor, so it is not credited as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: an assistant embedded in the product UI, documentation of which tasks can be delegated and how they are executed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
